segments.text: Sounds good.

segments.text: Our product is simple to use with some training,

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: and that's where you come into the picture.

segments.speaker: Speaker
segments.text: In the next two weeks, you'll become experts of Logiteam.

segments.speaker: Speaker
